# National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI)

> NAMI is the nation's largest grassroots mental health organization providing free peer support, educational resources, and advocacy for individuals living with mental illness and their families.

NAMI operates as a 501(c)3 nonprofit with 700+ state organizations and local affiliates across the United States. The organization provides multilingual support through helplines, community programs, and comprehensive mental health resources for diverse audiences including teens, young adults, and family caregivers.

## Key Topics

- NAMI Helpline
- Peer Support

## Support Services & Helplines

- [NAMI HelpLine](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline): Free nationwide peer-support helpline for mental health support
- [Teen & Young Adult HelpLine](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/teen-young-adult-helpline): Free peer-support helpline for teens and young adults
- [Family Caregiver HelpLine](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/family-caregiver-helpline): Free helpline and support programs for family caregivers
- [Línea de ayuda de NAMI](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/linea-de-ayuda-de-nami): Spanish-language NAMI helpline for mental health support
- [NAMI HelpLine FAQs](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org): FAQ and resources for NAMI HelpLine services
- [The Heart of the NAMI HelpLine: Volunteers](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/the-heart-of-the-nami-helpline-volunteers): Stories of NAMI helpline volunteers supporting mental health

## Mental Health Education & Living Resources

- [Living With a Mental Health Condition](https://www.nami.org/living-with-a-mental-health-condition): Guide to living with mental illness: conditions, support, resources
- [Finding a Mental Health Professional](https://www.nami.org/living-with-a-mental-health-condition/finding-a-mental-health-professional): Guide to finding and selecting mental health professionals
- [Understanding Health Insurance](https://www.nami.org/living-with-a-mental-health-condition/understanding-health-insurance): Guide to health insurance for mental health coverage and access

## Organization & Community

- [National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI)](https://www.nami.org): NAMI homepage: nation's largest grassroots mental health organization
- [Who We Are](https://www.nami.org/who-we-are): NAMI organization overview, mission, leadership, and history
- [Find Your Local NAMI](https://www.nami.org/find-your-local-nami): Directory of 700+ NAMI state organizations and local affiliates
- [Stay Connected](https://www.nami.org/stay-connected): NAMI community connection hub: blogs, helpline, events, resources
